precepts.text: David and the captains of the host separated the sons of Asaph, of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who should prophesy with harps, with psalteries, and with cymbals; musicians prophesying with instruments of music.
precepts.point: The songs we make and listen to, now that we know the truth, should be spiritual songs; the psalms were the jams of that day, and every one of them is deep, teaching who the daughter of Babylon is, the crafty counsel taken against us, and that the law was given to Israel.

note.label: 1 Samuel 16: The Lord Looketh on the Heart

precepts.why:
Saul’s servants proposed the remedy: “seek out a man, who is a cunning player on an harp: and it shall come to pass, when the evil spirit from God is upon thee, that he shall play with his hand, and thou shalt be well.” Our people understood back then that music is spiritual. The right playing could relieve an evil spirit.

“Moreover David and the captains of the host separated to the service of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who should prophesy with harps, with psalteries, and with cymbals”. Musicians prophesying with instruments of music.

precepts.text: Miriam the prophetess took a timbrel in her hand, and all the women went out after her with timbrels and with dances, showing that music is a form of prophecy.
precepts.point: The sons of Asaph prophesied according to the order of the king, the sons of Jeduthun prophesied with a harp to give thanks and to praise the Lord, and the sons of Heman were given by God to lift up the horn, for God gave Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 25: The Singers and Musicians of the Sanctuary

precepts.why:
“And Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a timbrel in her hand; and all the women went out after her with timbrels and with dances.” When Miriam came out, she led the women in prophecy, and it was with music. Music is a form of prophecy.

That is why David and the captains separated the sons of Asaph, Heman and Jeduthun, “who should prophesy with harps, with psalteries, and with cymbals”. The sons of Asaph “prophesied according to the order of the king”, and Jeduthun “prophesied with a harp, to give thanks and to praise the Lord.” The sons of Heman were given by God to lift up the horn, for God gave Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

points: David and the captains of the host separated to the service the sons of Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun, who should prophesy with harps, psalteries, and cymbals. Music is a form of prophecy. Miriam, when she came out, prophesied with the women, leading them in prophecy which was with music.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 25: The Singers and Musicians of the Sanctuary

points: The sons of Asaph prophesied according to the order of the king, the sons of Jeduthun prophesied with a harp to give thanks and to praise the Lord, and the sons of Heman were given by God to lift up the horn, for God gave Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 25: The Singers and Musicians of the Sanctuary

points: All these were under the hands of their father for song in the house of the Lord with cymbals, psalteries, and harps, for the service of God, according to the king's order. Just as with Asaph, all the sons were doing the same thing the father did; if he was a musician, his son was a musician, kept in the family.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 25: The Singers and Musicians of the Sanctuary

points: The number of them with their brethren that were instructed in the songs of the Lord, all that were cunning, was two hundred fourscore and eight. They cast lots, ward against ward, as well the small as the great, the teacher as the scholar.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 25: The Singers and Musicians of the Sanctuary

points: The first lot came forth for Asaph to Joseph, the second to Gedaliah, and so on through the twenty and four courses of the singers, each with his sons and his brethren being twelve. The number twelve is mentioned on purpose, patterned after the twelve tribes of Israel, as many things in the temple order are done with the twelve tribes in mind.
